images.source: 5 GreenPal-hosted before/after lawn photos (greenpal-production.s3.amazonaws.com), all of the same North Miami-area property from different angles/visits, provided directly in the task brief as the confirmed photo set for this business. Downloaded with curl + Chrome UA, verified with `file` as real 340x255 JPEGs (GreenPal's fixed native photo size, same as the otechlandscaping precedent). Every photo carried a baked-in 'GREENPAL' logo watermark (top ~42px band) and a 'Lawn Service by Valeria Landscape Se' caption band (bottom ~34px); all 5 were visually inspected and cropped with Pillow (top 42px + bottom 34px removed, leaving 340x179px) to remove both text overlays before use, per DESIGN.md's prohibition on gallery captures with text over them. Additionally downloaded the vendor's GreenPal profile headshot image (https://greenpal-production.s3.amazonaws.com/k5agrf2k44j0hlxlxz6qji902uge, a 300x400 PNG headshot, likely David Rodriguez Boza) and cropped it to a 300x300 square for use ONLY as a small circular avatar in the About/Experience section (never as a gallery tile), per DESIGN.md's rule against owner selfies/portraits in the gallery.

curation_note: All 6 photos used (5 property photos + 1 founder headshot avatar) are real, verified GreenPal-sourced work photos or a real founder headshot; none are stock or unrelated. All 5 property photos show the same recurring serviced property from different angles/visits (GreenPal's only available photo set for this vendor, matching the task brief's 5-photo list exactly), so the gallery grid was deliberately reduced from the skeleton's default 6-tile (1 wide + 5) layout to a curated 4-tile even grid (no wide tile) rather than padding with a 6th unrelated or duplicate image, per the pipeline rule 'menos fotos buenas > rellenar con malas'. Every source photo required watermark cropping (see images.source above) before use. The map/address section (variante adaptada, no publicly verifiable service address) was replaced with a real curated photo instead of a Google Maps embed.
brand_vibe: Independent, hands-on South Florida lawn care operation run by a single owner-operator (David Rodriguez Boza) who grew up around Miami's landscaping and turned that into his own GreenPal-booked business in 2023. No storefront, no fixed price list, no online booking flow of its own: everything runs through the GreenPal marketplace. Fresh teal palette (distinct from the forest/turf greens already used on other landscaping builds in this batch, and from the parallel Rapalo Landscaping North Miami build) on a light warm-white base, evoking clean, well-kept, freshly cleared yards without repeating the 'lawn green' cliche used elsewhere.
